summary: A valid one-step AGT sparse-grid certificate yields a direct violation of the claimed pure-DP inequality after binary thresholding. A separate final-batch policy yields a false stability certificate on adjacent20/19-record datasets. Pointwise sensitivity and per-batch gradient bounds survive bounded checks.
